title: Create the private ECR OCI GitOps foundation
expected_outcome: Private ECR OCI repositories and least-privilege identities permit a VPC-internal GitOps runner and Argo CD to consume reviewed, digest-pinned deployment artifacts without NAT or public listeners.
constraints: No Vault initialization, unseal, secret material, public endpoints, workload deployment, or release-signing activation.
Every image and OCI artifact is digest-pinned; no mutable deployment tag is accepted.

external_actions: create approved ECR, IAM, VPC endpoint, and VPC-internal CodeBuild foundation resources
publish only reviewed non-secret GitOps artifacts to their private ECR destination
